query: "Recent studies on nonstationary data streams focus on frequency domain analysis using frequency-filtering metadescriptors to identify concept drift. Topics include scalable clustering, meta-learning encoders, robust diagnostics, and reproducibility. Key methods filter frequency components by variance for concept separation."
